read: the observed 80->160 size dependence of the vertical (q2-q0) difference matches the static-eps point-charge model (residual 0.02 eV) and is ~3x milder than the electronically screened (eps_inf) point-charge worst case (residual 0.35 eV) -- consistent with a partially delocalized PBE charge state; the check is an empirical bound on the image channel, and the relaxed thermodynamic levels use static screening, which is the correct regime for them
